title: TowneBank Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
author: Not Specified
description: TowneBank (NASDAQ: TOWN) announced a second-quarter cash dividend of $0.28 per share, representing a 3.7% increase from the previous rate. The bank also approved a one-time $25 million donation to the TowneBank Foundation following the sale of its Resort Property Management business for $250 million in April 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company increased its quarterly dividend by 3.7%, demonstrating confidence in financial performance and commitment to shareholder returns. Additionally, the successful sale of the Resort Property Management business for $250 million and a $25 million charitable donation to the foundation reflect strong financial health and strategic capital allocation.

title: TowneBank Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
author: Na
description: TowneBank announced a 3.7% increase in its quarterly dividend to $0.28 per share, raising the annual rate to $1.12. Following the sale of its Resort Property Management business for $250 million and a special dividend of $0.70 per share, the bank's board approved a $25 million donation to the TowneBank Foundation to support charitable organizations in its service communities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company demonstrated strong financial health through a 3.7% dividend increase, a $250 million asset sale, a special dividend payment, and a significant $25 million charitable donation. These actions indicate solid earnings, strategic portfolio optimization, and commitment to shareholder returns and community investment.

title: TowneBank Announces Special Cash Dividend
author: Na
description: TowneBank (NASDAQ:TOWN) announced a special one-time cash dividend of $0.70 per share payable May 20, 2026, totaling approximately $65 million. The dividend represents roughly 32% of the estimated $203 million pre-tax gain from the sale of its Resort Property Management business completed on April 3, 2026 for $250 million.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully divested a non-core business at a substantial valuation ($250 million) and is returning a significant portion of gains to shareholders through a special dividend. This demonstrates successful execution of their strategy to build intrinsic value through non-bank business investments and indicates strong capital management and shareholder-friendly policies.

title: TowneBank Announces Sale of Resort Property Management Segment
author: Na
description: TowneBank (NASDAQ: TOWN) completed the sale of its Resort Property Management segment, Towne Vacations, to Belcrest Vacations Acquisitions, LLC for $250 million. The bank's leadership stated the transaction creates shareholder value and positions the business for future growth under new ownership.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The sale of Towne Vacations for $250 million is framed as a value-creation opportunity for shareholders. Management emphasizes the transaction is 'financially compelling' and positions the business with a capable partner for future growth. The divestiture allows TowneBank to focus on core banking operations while realizing capital from a non-core asset.

title: TowneBank Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
author: Na
description: TowneBank (NASDAQ: TOWN), a Hampton Roads-based bank with $19.69 billion in total assets, announced a first-quarter shareholder cash dividend of $0.27 per common share payable on April 10, 2026. The bank operates over 70 banking offices across Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, offering comprehensive banking and financial services through multiple affiliated companies.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The declaration of a consistent quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share demonstrates financial stability and profitability, indicating management confidence in the bank's earnings capacity and commitment to returning value to shareholders. The bank's substantial asset base of $19.69 billion and extensive geographic footprint further support positive sentiment.
